description: A pure CALCULATION node — boolean of two 2D shapes: Union · Subtract · Intersect · XOR. Coordinates in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes two shapes A and B as coordinate lists and returns the boolean result as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas — wire val-polygons into a Polygon node when you want it drawn.

INPUT: `a` (Shape A) and `b` (Shape B) each take an outline as JSON [[x,y],...] metre pairs, OR a nested list [[[x,y],...],...]; a nested list is read with the EVEN-ODD rule, so a Mitered-Join poché (outer + room holes) is treated as a holed shape, not a solid fill. Wire val-polygons / val-points into valin-a and valin-b.

OP: Union (A ∪ B) merges; Subtract (A − B) cuts B out of A; Intersect (A ∩ B) keeps the overlap; XOR keeps the non-overlap. Order matters for Subtract — A is the main shape, B the tool.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes the result as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list (outer + hole rings), which a Polygon node draws even-odd.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
